The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center and the left quarter panel shows a
crease that runs into the trunk lid, which is consistent with the reported rear impact.

broken away from its mount. No prior damage has come to light in the inspection, and
the paint film shows no sign of earlier repairs. The plan is to replace the bumper
cover and tail lamp, straighten the quarter panel, and refinish the affected areas.
Two similar charges posted to the file on the same day are being verified before
payment. The labor hours are slightly high for this scope of work and are under review
